title: First hearing Parker with Jay McShann
summary: Cootie first heard Charlie Parker with Jay McShann's band.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: I don't know. But he didn't blend in with my section.
Well, you see, he was with Earl.
Yeah.
He and Dizzy went with Earl, and Earl certainly wasn't playing music like that then. You know.
No.
I think they did "Night in Tunisia" or something. I think Dizzy got it written, or somebody got it arranged, or something. But, I mean, the band wasn't playing like that.
No.
So he certainly couldn't have been blending in Earl's band either. In fact, they were with Earl before they were with you.
Yeah.
Before Charlie was with you. And they must have been, you know, just experimenting. They were. They were just finding themselves, really.
But he was with Jay McShann.
That's right. He was with Jay McShann before Earl, wasn't he?
Yeah. Uh-huh.
But that wasn't a big band, though, was it?
Yeah. That's where I heard Charlie Parker.
Oh, is it?
Uh-huh.
Was that a band with sections?
Yeah. That's where I heard him at.
Is it?
With Jay McShann's band.
And right away, you thought to yourself --
Yeah.
Is that right? Because, I mean, not a lot of people had -- oh, then, I see. Cootie, then he must have gone with him after Earl, I think. As far as I can think. Well, I may have my dates wrong.
Well, he had a great talent.
